topic: The Daily Habit Ep 4: today's 8 stories (Binance hit by record crypto breach; Claude's smart reports for bosses; UPI: 55.49 crore users onboarded; Claude flags potential misuse; Free textbooks inside Gemini; India No.2 in AI shopping; Google: AI search earns less; Indian AI firm eyes $3B for chips)
angle_hint: An episode digest carousel: slide 1 a bold hook naming the biggest story and that there are 8 stories today; then one stat, compare or fact slide per story for the first five stories in the episode's order (each with its own source); a close slide inviting people to watch the full episode for all of them.

facts.text: Binance estimates about $6.3 Bn in assets was affected, which the article says appears to be the largest crypto heist on record; about $3 Bn has been frozen on-chain.
Binance says it will cover all losses through its SAFU fund and company funds. Withdrawals are temporarily suspended and expected to be restored in the next 48 hours.
Binance's initial investigation suggests the incident may involve a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop; it found no evidence of any wallet private key leak.
Tether reports freezing over $1.57 Bn in USDT and Circle over $800 Mn in USDC. Chainalysis puts the theft at roughly $5.9 Bn.
India angle: Indian exchange CoinDCX halted new trades on its futures desk as a precaution. Binance restarted operations in India in 2024 after registering with the FIU.

Anthropic's smart reports for Claude Enterprise are now generally available. They analyze a sample of a selected team's transcripts and group the work into workstreams, showing spend, deliverables produced and the most common points of friction.

The Inefficiencies section counts sessions that produced nothing usable and sessions that were personal or off-topic, with their cost, shown only as an aggregate count and cost, with no summaries or drilldown. Personal conversations also don't include individual sessions or names.
Smart reports are off by default and must be turned on in the organization's settings. The role required to enable them is Primary Owner or Owner.
Anthropic says smart reports 'should not be used for evaluating individual performance or making employment decisions.' They are meant for adoption and investment planning.
The same announcement added pooled group budgets, which let admins set one shared budget per team, and in-app surveys that capture the team's own feedback.
About 55.49 crore users had onboarded on UPI as of June 2026.
In FY26, UPI handled 24,161.69 crore transactions worth Rs 314.23 lakh crore (about US$ 3.56 trillion).
For comparison, FY22 had 4,595.61 crore UPI transactions worth Rs 84.16 lakh crore.
The government shared the figures in a Lok Sabha reply (Minister of State for Finance Pankaj Chaudhary), as reported by Outlook Money on 22 July 2026.
After Claude responds, it gives a preliminary safety assessment of the conversation, flagging potential misuse; Anthropic calls this technique 'self-assessment'.
Anthropic says that since it began using self-assessment in June, it has surfaced misuse that its other safeguards weren't designed to catch.
Each assessment records the reason for the flag, the harm category, a priority level and whether Claude refused. Users don't see these assessments.

A flag is not automatically treated as a policy violation and does not block the user; assessments help Anthropic prioritise cases for human review. Anthropic says the system does not collect additional data, though flagged conversations may be retained for investigation under applicable policies.

Anthropic reports that on Claude Fable 5, self-assessment identifies 78% of potentially harmful conversations flagged by a more resource-intensive classifier; for high-priority conversations the figure is 94%, with a reported false-positive rate of 1%.
Google has added a catalogue of "hundreds of textbooks" to Gemini Notebook, free for students in India and the United States; no exact count is given.
Providers are New Delhi-based S Chand Publishing, OpenStax and Open Textbook Library.
To use it: open a Gemini Notebook, click Add sources, choose Textbooks, then pick a book from the list.
Once a book is chosen, every question is answered from that book. Responses include inline citations and direct links to the original textbook sources.
Students can generate study guides, practice quizzes and flashcards from the chosen textbook.
76% of consumers in India use AI for shopping, per McKinsey research; China (80%) and India (76%) lead adoption among the 11 markets surveyed.
China is highest at 80% of consumers using AI for shopping.
Average across the 11 markets surveyed is 53% of consumers using AI for shopping, so India is well above it.
The survey covers about 21,000 consumers across 11 markets.
Alphabet's Q3 2026 revenue was $127.6B, up 25% year over year, with Google Cloud revenue at $30.7B (up 103%).
Google's Philipp Schindler said each AI Mode query currently makes less than a traditional search, and he expects monetization to improve over time.
Google's Philipp Schindler announced the expansion of ads in AI Mode into international markets, alongside multi-turn ads in AI Mode in the U.S.
Shares fell about 9% after hours, from a close near $325 to about $290, a level last seen in April's sell-off.
GAAP EPS was $2.12, missing consensus by $0.89 (nearly 30%). Revenue was about $330M short of expectations.

CNBC headline: 'Indian AI firm seeks to raise $3 billion to buy Nvidia chips: report'. The body says the AI infrastructure firm is reportedly planning to raise up to $3 billion in debt (bonds and bank loans) to buy Nvidia's Rubin GPUs.
The firm is AM Intelligence, which plans to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchases through bank loans and bonds.

Per Whalesbook, the chips are intended to power a 1-gigawatt computing facility planned for Hyderabad, part of a larger $8 billion infrastructure project. CNBC reports different figures: 100 MW across Malaysia and India, and $6 billion.
The firm is reportedly relying on $300 million in advance payments from potential customers to offset some of the borrowing.
The firm is founded by the team behind Greenko Group.

cautions: Loss figures are early and vary. $6.3 Bn is Binance's estimate of total impact, early reports of outflows were $2.5-3.3 Bn, and Chainalysis says about $5.9 Bn. Don't present $6.3 Bn as money 'stolen and gone', because about $3 Bn is frozen.
North Korea/Lazarus attribution (TRM Labs, ZachXBT) is unconfirmed by Binance. Don't state it as fact.
The 48-hour withdrawal resumption is Binance's expectation, not a guarantee. The cause is a preliminary finding.
Don't link the ED's ₹4,940 Cr probe (Mudrex etc.) to the Binance breach. Inc42 doesn't connect them.
Forbes was not readable (403). The Inc42 and CoinDesk figures were read directly. A web search surfaced other outlets, which I did not open.
I could not open the Mashable article. These facts come from Anthropic's own pages, not Mashable's reporting.

The 'tells bosses when workers are off-topic' framing is overstated. By Anthropic's docs, off-topic use appears only as an aggregate count and cost, not per person, unless an optional attribution toggle is turned on.
It's an Enterprise-only feature, and admins have to switch it on. It is not on for everyone using Claude.
Anthropic's help pages still call smart reports beta in places, while the blog says generally available. Some secondary sources say beta began in September.
Don't say bosses can read employees' chats. Reports analyze a sample of transcripts and give summaries.
I did not confirm whether the optional individual-attribution toggle shows off-topic use per person.
55.49 crore is onboarded users as of June 2026, not active users and not FY26 transactions.
